targets.rationale: The supported day-level operation is to move the existing Atlas board demo to July 3. The model updated evt_48 in place from July 6 to July 3, preserving its stored start time and duration. Full before/after stores show one demo and no July 6 duplicate, with the independent beta-feedback task and code-freeze event unchanged. The key's freeze-plus-11-days resolves to the explicitly requested July 3, so the PASS is justified. The inherited nondefault time/duration is a historical issue recorded separately, not a failure of this date-move check.
